key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/version.library:0:009E
name: store_two_long_fields
description: Writes two 32-bit values, one taken from an address register and one from the frame base register, into two fixed fields of a structure whose pointer is in a data register, then returns. The values' meaning is not recoverable from this body alone.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/version.library:0:00AA
name: increment_counter_and_clear_bit
description: Adds one to a 16-bit counter at a fixed offset from the base pointer and clears bit 3 of a flag byte at another offset from the same base. It performs only these two updates and then returns.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/version.library:0:00B8
name: decrement_counter_and_call
description: Subtracts one from a 16-bit counter in the structure. When the counter reaches zero and bit 3 of a flag byte in the same structure is set, it calls one other routine from this library and returns its result; otherwise it returns zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/version.library:0:00CE
name: forward_value_or_set_flag
description: If the counter in the structure is zero, it calls two library routines through a pointer stored in the structure and returns a stored 32-bit value. Otherwise it sets bit 3 of a flag byte and returns zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/version.library:0:00EA
name: read_field_then_call_library
description: Reads a 32-bit field from a structure, calls two library functions through the library base, and returns the value read before those calls. The calls' results are discarded.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/version.library:0:0112
name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing except return zero, with no other behaviour.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:0:0000
name: store_argument_in_result
description: Calls a library function through the library base and, if it returns a non-null pointer, stores the argument at a fixed field of that pointer and then calls a second library function. It returns whether the first call produced a non-null result.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:0:0050
name: store_argument_when_call_succeeds
description: Calls a library function through the library base and, when it returns a non-null pointer, stores the argument into a field of that pointer and calls a second library function through the base. It returns a boolean that is true only when the first call succeeded.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:0:0080
name: open_libraries_init_list
description: Opens two libraries by name through the exec routines, using the library names found in the referenced text. When both open, it initializes an empty list header inside the structure and returns the structure; otherwise it runs the cleanup path and returns zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:0:00E4
name: close_library_and_free
description: Closes a library and frees a memory block through exec, then returns zero. It is the cleanup path used when opening fails.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:0:0182
name: release_unused_list_entries
description: Walks a linked list and removes each entry whose count has dropped below one, unloading its code segment through dos. If the owning structure's flag and count are then both clear, it closes libraries, frees the structure and returns a stored value; otherwise it sets bit 7 of a flag byte and returns zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:0:01DA
name: close_and_free_when_idle
description: When a flag word and a count in the structure are both zero, it closes two libraries through exec, frees the structure, unlinks it from its list, and returns a stored value. Otherwise it sets bit 7 of a flag byte and returns zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:0:0242
name: set_flag_bit_return_zero
description: Sets the most significant bit of a flag byte at a fixed offset in the structure and returns zero. It only updates that flag.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:0:024A
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately with no work. It is an empty routine.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:0:024C
name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Clears the most significant bit of a flag byte in the structure and adds one to a 16-bit counter at another position. It returns nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:0:025A
name: decrement_counter_and_call_library
description: Subtracts one from a 16-bit counter in the structure. When the counter reaches zero and the top bit of a flag byte is set, it calls one library routine through the library base and returns that result; otherwise it returns zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:0:026C
name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns zero with no other work. Its body is only the return value, so it always gives the same fixed result.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:3:0000
name: collect_entries_into_buffer
description: Fills a caller buffer with fixed-size entry records, first from a linked list of named items and then optionally from a second source read through a temporary 260-byte buffer. Each record holds a copied name and some attributes, and the routine returns how far the buffer overflowed, or zero when everything fit.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:3:003E
name: append_list_entries_to_buffer
description: Appends a fixed-size entry record for each named item in a linked list to a caller buffer, using a loop over the list. It returns how far the buffer overflowed, or zero when everything fit, and the optional second source is handled in the same way as the list entries.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:3:0046
name: measure_names_and_append_entries
description: Walks a linked list of named items, measuring each name's length character by character and copying each name with its attributes into a caller buffer as an entry record. When the list ends it optionally reads further entries from a second source and returns the overflow amount, or zero when everything fit.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:3:0068
name: collect_fonts_directory_entries
description: Appends fixed-size entry records to a caller buffer for each named item in a linked list, then, when a flag bit is set, walks a directory under the FONTS path using dos lock, examine and current-directory calls. It returns how far the buffer overflowed, or zero when everything fit.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:3:0106
name: scan_font_files_for_entries
description: Walks a directory listing and selects names that match the referenced .font text, opens each one through dos, reads its records, and appends matching entries to the caller buffer. It returns how far the buffer overflowed, or zero when everything fit.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:3:0164
name: copy_name_and_append_record
description: Copies the characters of a name into a caller buffer, appends a fixed-size record describing it, and keeps walking the list of items. When the walk ends it returns the overflow amount, or zero when everything fit.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:3:0182
name: read_and_append_name_records
description: Copies name characters into a caller buffer and, for each name, uses dos read calls to fetch further records that are appended as entries. It returns the overflow amount when the walk finishes, or zero when everything fit.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:3:01B8
name: read_records_and_release_handles
description: Reads a fixed-size record for each item, appends an entry record to the caller buffer, and walks a directory structure through dos. At the end it unlocks and closes handles and frees memory, then returns the overflow amount or zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:3:025C
name: return_zero_fixed_value
description: Returns zero without touching registers, memory or hardware. It is an empty routine apart from that result.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:7:0000
name: compute_weighted_difference_score
description: Returns a large negative sentinel when one structure's 16-bit field is zero. Otherwise it computes a scaled difference between two 16-bit fields and subtracts a table-weighted term for each of seven bit positions where two byte fields differ.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:7:002E
name: subtract_masked_weights_from_base
description: Starts from a supplied base value and subtracts a table-weighted term for each of seven bit positions where two byte fields of the structures differ. It returns the adjusted value and is the inner loop of the comparison above it.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:7:0082
name: accumulate_masked_table_weights
description: Walks seven bit positions under masks the caller sets, and for each position subtracts a table entry chosen by the bits of a byte field in the structure. It returns the reduced accumulator after the last position.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:7:00B8
name: subtract_bit_table_terms
description: Subtracts table-weighted terms for each bit position in two byte fields of a structure, walking seven positions, and returns the reduced accumulator. It is a variant of the accumulator routine with the bit tests in a different order.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:7:00D2
name: return_constant_value
description: Takes no input and returns a fixed large negative constant. It works as a sentinel result.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:7:00E0
name: select_best_records_into_list
description: Starts by looking up an entry through graphics and returns it early when a follow-up check matches. Otherwise it reads a table of fixed-size records from a file, repeatedly selects the highest-scoring record, and links records of one type into a list, returning the last linked entry or the initial one.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:7:0142
name: link_fonts_directory_records
description: Locks the FONTS path through dos, reads a table of fixed-size records from a file, and repeatedly selects the highest-scoring record while linking records of one type into a list. It releases the lock and returns the last linked entry, or the initial one if none was linked.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:7:015E
name: link_font_records_from_file
description: Reads a table of fixed-size records from a file opened by the caller, then repeatedly selects the highest-scoring record and links records of one type into a list. It releases its handles and returns the last linked entry, or the initial one if none was linked.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:7:021C
name: link_highest_scoring_records
description: Repeatedly selects the highest-scoring fixed-size record in a table and links records of one type into a list, updating their counters. When no record remains it releases handles and returns the last linked entry.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:7:0224
name: link_best_records_register_fonts
description: Selects the highest-scoring fixed-size record and links records of one type into a list, releasing handles and returning the last linked entry when none remain. Its call list also includes directory, segment-loading and font-registration helpers.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:7:0304
name: clear_and_link_best_records
description: Clears one record marker and then repeatedly selects the highest-scoring record, linking records of one type into a list. When none remain it releases handles and unloads a code segment through dos, then returns the last linked entry.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:7:0322
name: clear_and_release_font_records
description: Clears one record marker and repeatedly selects the highest-scoring record, linking records of one type into a list. When none remain it closes files, unlocks, frees memory and closes fonts before returning the last linked entry.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:5:0000
name: build_font_index_table
description: Splits a file name at its extension, locks the containing directory through dos and counts the matching entries. It then allocates a table, copies each matching entry's name and attribute bytes into it, and returns the table's entry area, or null when any step fails.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:5:00BA
name: load_disk_font_table
description: Allocates a memory block for a table and writes a header holding its size and an initial zero count. It then scans directory entries through dos, copies the name and attribute bytes of each font entry into the table and increments the count, returning the entry area or null after freeing the block if a step failed.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:5:0240
name: free_sized_memory_block
description: Frees a memory block by passing its address and the size stored in its first four bytes to the exec memory-free routine. It is a thin wrapper.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:13:0000
name: disable_task_switching
description: Calls the exec routine that disables task switching through the library base and returns. It is a thin wrapper with no other logic.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:13:0010
name: enable_task_switching
description: Calls the exec routine that re-enables task switching through the library base and returns. It is a thin wrapper with no other logic.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:13:0020
name: allocate_memory_block
description: Calls the exec allocation routine through the library base and returns its result. It is a thin wrapper that requests a memory block.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:0000
name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination until and including the terminating zero byte.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:0010
name: append_string_to_end
description: Advances to the terminating zero byte of the destination string and then calls the string copy routine to append the source string there.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:001A
name: skip_to_string_end_call
description: Advances a pointer to the terminating zero byte of a string and passes that position to another routine. It does no other work.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:002C
name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the bytes before the terminating zero byte of a string and returns that count.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:0034
name: count_bytes_including_terminator
description: Advances through a zero-terminated string while counting each byte, including the terminator, and returns that count.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:003C
name: compare_two_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte and returns negative one when the first is smaller at the first difference, one when it is larger, and zero when they are equal.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:0046
name: compare_string_after_leading_byte
description: Compares a zero-terminated string that starts one byte past the first pointer with a second string, and returns zero at a zero leading byte. Otherwise it returns negative one when the first string is greater at the first difference and one when it is smaller.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:004E
name: compare_strings_until_mismatch
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings from their start and returns zero when they match. At the first difference it returns negative one when the first string is greater and one when it is smaller.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:0062
name: find_char_in_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string from its start for a given byte and returns a pointer to the first match, or null when the byte is absent.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:006C
name: search_forward_for_char
description: Walks forward from a pointer through a zero-terminated string and returns the position of the first byte matching the character supplied in a register, or null. It is the register-based form of the search that starts at the pointer.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:0074
name: find_char_after_pointer
description: Starts one byte past the given pointer and scans forward for a byte value, returning its position or null when the terminator is reached first.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:007E
name: find_last_char_in_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and scans backward from its last byte for the given value, returning the position of the last match or null.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:009C
name: search_backward_for_char
description: Walks backward from a pointer for a given byte, stopping at a lower bound, and returns the position of the first match found or null.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:00A4
name: search_backward_within_bound
description: Steps backward from a pointer one byte at a time, checking the lower bound before each comparison, and returns the matching position or null when the bound is passed first.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:00B2
name: skip_past_path_separator
description: Returns a pointer just past the first slash in a string, or just past its colon when there is no slash. It returns the original pointer when neither character is present.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:9:00DA
name: increment_input_value
description: Returns its input value plus one. It is a trivial helper with no other logic.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:1:0000
name: forward_call_to_handler
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns, with no other logic. The callee is not shown, so this body does not reveal its purpose.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:1:0012
name: dispatch_to_external_handler
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns, with no other logic. Its only role is forwarding, so the purpose depends on the callee, which is not shown.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:1:001E
name: forward_call_to_callee
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns without any other operation. The callee is not shown, so this body does not reveal its purpose.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/diskfont.library:1:002C
name: call_callee_and_return
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns, with no additional operations. It is a pure forwarding stub.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:play2:0:0000
name: start_program_and_clear_state
description: Program entry that saves the incoming register values into fixed memory and clears a block of 96 longwords. It then opens a library through exec, calls a stored handler when one is set, closes the library and returns a saved result.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:play2:0:008A
name: run_handler_and_close_library
description: Calls a stored handler function from a structure when one is set, then closes a library through exec and returns a saved result. It works as a shutdown helper.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:play2:0:0140
name: prepare_state_and_run_steps
